CITY COUNCIL OF MONTEREY PARK
  CITY COUNCIL SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA

  NOTICE OF CITY COUNCIL SPECIAL COMMUNITY MEETING

  As a quorum of the City Council may be present for the event, this special meeting
  notice is being issued for the purpose of the Brown Act pursuant to Government
  Code Section 54956. 1 Members of the City Council present will not formally
  convene as a body, nor will they take any formal action at the event.

  MEETUP WITH THE MAYOR

  Jumpin’ Lobster
  2120 S. Atlantic Blvd., Monterey Park 91754

  Monday
  March 23, 2026
  5:00 p.m. – 6:00 p.m.

  I.  Welcome

  II.  Community members are invited for casual conversations and to learn more
  about the City with the Mayor of Monterey Park.

  III.  Adjournment

minutes_text:
74-144

  Minutes
  Monterey Park City Council
  Special Community Meeting
  March 23, 2026

The City Council of the City of Monterey Park held a Special Community Meeting of the
Council at Jumpin’ Lobster located at 2120 S. Atlantic Blvd., Monterey Park, CA, 91754
on Monday, March 23, 2026 at 5:00 p.m.

1.  Call to Order
  City Manager Inez Alvarez called the meeting to order at 5:00 p.m.

2.  Roll Call

  City Manager Alvarez called the roll:

  Council Members Present: Elizabeth Yang, Henry Lo, Jose Sanchez
  Council Members Absent: Vinh Ngo, Thomas Wong

  Also Present:
  Assistant City Manager Diana Garcia
  Director of Finance Martha Garcia
  Director of Recreation and Community Services Robert Aguirre
  Director of Community Development Timothy Hou
  Director of Public Works Shawn Igoe
  Police Chief Scott Wiese
  Economic Development Manager Joseph Torres
  Fire Battalion Chief Ryan Weddle
  Economic Development Specialist Janice Huang
  City Communications Fellow Citlali Tejeda

  Meet Up with The Mayor

  I.  Welcome: The meeting was called to order at 5:00 p.m.

  II.  Community members are invited for casual conversations and to learn
  more about the City with the Mayor of Monterey Park.

  MISSION STATEMENT
 The mission of the City of Monterey Park is to provide excellent service, foster growth and opportunity,
  and create a joyous and collaborative environment.
  .
   74-145
  March 23, 2026
III.  Adjournment at 6:30 p.m.

  There being no further business for consideration, the meeting was
  adjourned at 6:17 p.m.

  Action Taken: No reportable action taken.

_________________
Maychelle Yee
City Clerk

  Approved on July 1, 2026, at the Regular City Council Meeting
